name: Saint Leo the Great
history: Pope at a time of collapse, Leo defined the Church's faith that Christ is one Person in two natures, a teaching the Council of Chalcedon received with the cry 'Peter has spoken through Leo'. He met Attila the Hun outside Rome and persuaded him to turn back.
meditation: Christian, remember your dignity. What would change if you believed it today?
